answer: Operator-Liability Escrow. Each wallet posts an escrow bond; a sybil flag freezes that bond and opens a public review, and confirmed duplication pushes the operator into a penalty spiral where their remaining wallets inherit escalating escrow minimums. The penalty attaches to the operator's shared payout address, so a whisper of suspicion raises costs across all clones. Funds are held at a neutral wharf account until review clears. Attacker cost: one full escrow per identity plus rising minimums on every unburned wallet.
